input.quote: The parties agree that the limitation of liability in this paragraph reflects the allocation of risk between the parties and the price of the licenced Software. The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
input.rationale: Section 15, despite its heading, contains no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement (no "exceed"/"aggregate liability" language exists), so each party's direct-damages exposure is unlimited. The mutual consequential-damages exclusion and the carve-out of Sections 13 (Intellectual Property Indemnity, including Garman's indemnity in p0090) and 14 (Confidentiality) are in place, which already satisfies the fallback carve-outs for indemnification and confidentiality, but the absence of any cap and of gross negligence / wilful misconduct exclusions fails the fallback on material terms. We therefore added, at fallback level, a mutual cap of twelve months' fees (lowercase fees under the Fee Schedule; there is no narrow defined "Fees" term) sitting inside Section 15 so the existing exclusions continue to apply, plus gross negligence and wilful misconduct as further exclusions.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-month fees liability cap in Section 15 and carve out gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 limits damages but sets no aggregate cap, so both parties are exposed without limit; we added a mutual cap at twelve months' fees, our fallback position. Breaches of Sections 13 (IP indemnity) and 14 (confidentiality) already sit outside Section 15, and we added gross negligence and wilful misconduct to those exclusions.

ops.text: Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by Sparkling under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall also not apply to a party's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
